title: Pakistan to host England, Sri Lanka in six-match ODI Tri-Series
desc: Pakistan will host England and Sri Lanka in a six-match ODI tri-series from October 18 to 31, with games in Rawalpindi and Lahore. The tournament will begin with Pakistan facing Sri Lanka, while the final will be played in Lahore. The busy schedule also includes Sri Lanka’s T20Is and a two-Test series against Pakistan in November.
